links.comparator_used: Rank-based audit (AUROC) and aggregate overall performance monitoring
links.outcome: Detection of installed subgroup underdiagnosis backdoor failures
links.effect: Subgroup false-negative rate audit at deployed threshold flagged 96% of installed failures vs 73% for a rank-based audit; overall AUROC moved only 0.004
links.tradeoff: Audit based on recorded demographics is blind to 30% of studies, since harm reached patients whose race was not recorded via the pixel shortcut
links.quote: What works is auditing subgroup false-negative rate at the deployed threshold, which flagged 96% of installed failures compared to 73% for a rank-based audit.

design_hint: subgroup false-negative rate audit at deployed operating threshold
